summary: Add inactive durable jobs schema and a bounded canonical history fold, including malformed-record and repair invalidation hardening.

replay.detail: Register jobs across append, replication, flush, rebuild and graph replay. Only job subjects are folded in shared canonical order; empty rebuild/replay writes nothing. Illegal transitions, binding conflicts and malformed records remain refused raw history. Direct and fields-enveloped bodies normalize identically. No whole-log fallback.

schema.detail: Add job.recorded/job subjects, durable retention, jobs/queue/history/receipt/pending tables and a partial jobs-claim index. Subject-scoped replica-record repair triggers enqueue affected jobs. Receipt-bearing claims never rotate away.

rules.detail: Host-authority evidence fields are private with no production constructor. Projected and replicated facts are history only, never execution grants. Gate-slot remains admission.

compatibility.detail: Inactive domain projection only. Indexed public queries, receipt population and read-only pending fences belong to stacked unit 4b. Existing projector order is preserved.

manual.detail: No operator action. Automatic runtime repair-page dispatch remains separately gated; existing domain hooks drain pending subjects.

recovery.detail: Explicit rebuild reconstructs canonical histories; malformed schema-admitted records cannot poison open/rebuild. Oversized subject refolds refuse before projection mutation.
